title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
summary: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.

title: Claude Fable 5.5, GPT 6.2 Astra Could Be Right Around the Corner, Leaks Suggest
summary: Users say Claude is routing some requests to a stronger unreleased model, a Mythos 5.5 label appeared in Anthropic’s site code, and OpenAI appears to be testing GPT-6.2 Astra.

title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
summary: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.

title: Claude-Built Linux Exploit Targets Bug That Ubuntu Still Hasn't Patched
summary: Anthropic says Claude wrote an attack that can take over a Linux server with no password. Red Hat patched on Sunday, but Ubuntu still has no fix.

title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
summary: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.

title: Animoca Brands clears final hurdle for Abu Dhabi fund management
summary: The former mobile games company is building out its fund management business in Abu Dhabi as it targets institutional demand for stablecoins and tokenized assets.

title: Nvidia and Nike Lead Biggest Wave Yet of Tokenized Stock Objections
summary: Nvidia, Costco, Nike and nine other companies objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 50.

title: Elon Musk Mocks Sam Altman Over Claim Home PCs Are Wasting RAM
summary: The OpenAI CEO said it's "quite terrible" for DRAM to sit largely idle in personal computers while AI data centers face a supply crunch.

title: SpaceX reportedly wants to buy Boost Mobile to compete with AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon
summary: SpaceX has been looking for new ways to use its Starlink network, and a tie-up with cellular operator Boost Mobile could give it the terrestrial access it needs.

title: Elon Musk throttles Grok Bot limits due to ‘unsustainably high’ costs

title: How T7X Is Building the Infrastructure for a New Era of Capital Markets

title: Binance hackers begin swapping stolen Solana tokens for Bitcoin: Chainalysis
